slice.question: Should durable artifact persistence and epistemic/reference validity share a success signal in long-running agent systems?

source.title: OpenCLAW-P2P v6.0: Resilient Multi-Layer Persistence, Live Reference Verification, and Production-Scale Evaluation of Decentralized AI Peer Review
source.evidence_surface: public search result carrying arXiv abstract text

reported_observations: The system describes four persistence tiers: in-memory cache, Cloudflare R2, Gun.js, and GitHub.
It describes a retrieval cascade with automatic backfill and reports lookup latency reduced from more than 3 seconds to under 50 milliseconds.
It adds live reference verification against CrossRef, arXiv, and Semantic Scholar and reports fabricated-citation detection above 85 percent.
The abstract reports operation with 14 real autonomous agents producing more than 50 scored papers and a recovery protocol that salvaged 25 lost papers.

material_revision.name: ARTIFACT_DURABILITY_REFERENCE_VALIDITY_SPLIT
material_revision.rule: Treat persistence/retrievability and epistemic/reference validity as separate state dimensions. Successful recovery or backfill proves availability, not current truth or citation validity; successful reference verification proves only the checked reference relation at its check time, not artifact durability.
material_revision.negative_test: Restore an older artifact successfully through a backfill path while one cited source is now missing, superseded, or invalid. The durability/retrieval check should pass, the reference-validity check should fail or become stale/unknown, and no combined success bit may promote the artifact to trusted evidence.
material_revision.audit_use: Add orthogonal durability and validity fields before any memory/retrieval success label is used for routing, promotion, or downstream verification priority.

evidence_contract.verifier: bounded manual reading of public arXiv abstract surfaced by search
evidence_contract.causal_credit: none beyond the source's stated system-level report; no controlled ablation was read, so no component-level positive action-value label is assigned
limitations: Only the abstract-level public evidence was used in this bounded slice.
The reported detection rate lacks an abstract-level denominator and calibration detail.
The source is a system/production report rather than a matched controlled causal study.
